source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with monumental misty mountains above marshy water, scattered thatched dwellings, trees, a small bridge, and a scholar in a boat; calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: central_dark_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central mountain peak rising from the mist, including the dark rounded summit, steep ink-washed flanks, pale mist seams, and lower attached mountain mass, but excluding the inscription area and unrelated foreground trees or huts.
must_preserve: broad layered gray-black wash forming the rounded summit
dry horizontal brush striations down the slopes
soft pale mist channels cutting along both sides
ink-dark lower shoulders and fading base edges
subtle tonal transitions from dense black to diluted gray

motifs.name: central_rock_buttresses
motifs.description: Isolate the pale exposed rock buttresses embedded in the front of the central mountain, with jagged ink contours, textured ridges, and dark side shadows.
must_preserve: angular contour linework around pale rock faces
short dark texture dabs along ridges
vertical and diagonal crevice strokes
gray wash modeling on the cliff planes
black clustered brush marks at the base and side edges

motifs.name: right_mist_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side mountain ridge and its adjoining mist pocket, including the dark rounded hill, sloping shoulder, distant pale blue-gray back hill, and soft white atmospheric gap below.
must_preserve: rounded dark ink summit on the right ridge
sloping layered wash strokes down the hillside
soft-edged white mist opening between mountain masses
faint blue-gray distant hill behind the ridge
blurred wet-wash transitions at the lower edge

motifs.name: left_distant_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the low rolling hills and distant blue-gray peaks on the left middle distance, including their misty bases and broad diluted ink washes.
must_preserve: pale blue-gray background peak
low dark rounded foreground hill silhouette
watery horizontal wash layers
mist-softened hill bases
minimal contour lines and diluted ink edges

motifs.name: midground_willow_reed_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the midground wetland thicket of thin willows and reeds left of the cottages, with pale water gaps and dark shrub crowns, avoiding the hut roofs.
must_preserve: fine vertical reed and willow stems
dark clustered leaf washes at the tops of small trees
pale negative-space water channels between trunks
thin ink outlines mixed with diluted gray wash
soft horizontal water strokes behind the vegetation

motifs.name: thatched_cottage_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small central thatched cottages beside water, including tan roofs, dark wall posts, doorway lines, and surrounding low shrubs, without taking the larger foreground grove.
must_preserve: warm tan thatched roof accents
black vertical wall and window strokes
slight roof eave geometry and overlapping roof planes
small surrounding dark shrub masses
watery gray ground reflection beneath the huts

motifs.name: left_plank_bridge_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the simple low plank bridge on the left lower bank together with the adjacent dark riverside trees and grasses that frame it, avoiding the central cottage cluster.
must_preserve: thin dark bridge planks and upright supports
dark rounded tree crowns at the left bank
slender tree trunks and branch forks
scratchy grass strokes along the shoreline
horizontal gray wash lines indicating shallow water

motifs.name: foreground_boat_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat with a standing scholar or boatman near the lower riverbank, including the hull, figure, pole or oar lines, and nearby curved bank grasses, while excluding the large foreground tree mass above it.
must_preserve: delicate narrow boat outline
tiny robed human figure in pale wash and black line
fine pole or oar strokes
curved grassy bank line beside the boat
open pale water around the hull for separation

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
